author: Amy Coleman

blocks.text: Amy Coleman, Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer, shared the below communication with Microsoft employees today.
blocks.zh: 艾米・科尔曼,执行副总统兼首席人民官,今天与微软员工分享了以下通信.
blocks.en: Amy Coleman, Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer, shared the below communication with Microsoft employees today.

blocks.text: Today, we’re introducing a new Voluntary Exit Offer (VEO) to eligible employees within participating organizations. This offer gives eligible employees who may be considering a future outside the company a new choice to make that transition now with support. It also gives participating organizations another way to adapt their workforce to changing needs.
blocks.zh: 今天,我们...我们正向参加组织内合格的员工推出新的自愿离职优惠。这一提议为可能考虑公司之外的未来的合格雇员提供了新的选择,以便在现在得到支持的情况下实现这一过渡。它还为参与组织提供了另一种方法,使其工作人员适应不断变化的需要。
blocks.en: Today, we’re introducing a new Voluntary Exit Offer (VEO) to eligible employees within participating organizations. This offer gives eligible employees who may be considering a future outside the company a new choice to make that transition now with support. It also gives participating organizations another way to adapt their workforce to changing needs.

blocks.text: The Voluntary Exit Offer reflects an important part of how we’re evolving our approach to change: creating greater flexibility and, where possible, more ways for employees to shape their next chapter. This builds on what we learned earlier this year through the Voluntary Retirement Program.
blocks.zh: “自愿退出”方案反映了我们如何改变方法的一个重要部分:创造更大的灵活性,在可能的情况下,更多的方法让员工 塑造他们的下一章。这借鉴了我们今年早些时候通过自愿退休方案学到的知识。
blocks.en: The Voluntary Exit Offer reflects an important part of how we’re evolving our approach to change: creating greater flexibility and, where possible, more ways for employees to shape their next chapter. This builds on what we learned earlier this year through the Voluntary Retirement Program.

blocks.text: This offer will be available to eligible employees in participating teams in Canada, India, the United Kingdom and the United States at level 70 and below. This is a time-limited, voluntary program that gives those who are eligible the opportunity to leave Microsoft with financial support and career planning resources. Some organizations are providing the Voluntary Exit Offer, and some are not. Participation varies based on each business’s priorities, customer commitments and workforce needs.
blocks.zh: 这一提议将提供给加拿大参加小组的合格雇员,印度联合王国和美国为70级及以下。这是有时间限制的,自愿方案,使有资格的人有机会离开微软,获得财政支助和职业规划资源。一些组织正在提供自愿退出服务,有些则不然。参与程度因企业的优先事项而异,客户承诺和劳动力需求。
blocks.en: This offer will be available to eligible employees in participating teams in Canada, India, the United Kingdom and the United States at level 70 and below. This is a time-limited, voluntary program that gives those who are eligible the opportunity to leave Microsoft with financial support and career planning resources. Some organizations are providing the Voluntary Exit Offer, and some are not. Participation varies based on each business’s priorities, customer commitments and workforce needs.

blocks.text: Eligible employees will receive an email with a link to their Voluntary Exit Offer details within the next few hours.
blocks.zh: 合格雇员将在今后几个小时内收到一封电子邮件,并与其自愿退出协议的详情链接。
blocks.en: Eligible employees will receive an email with a link to their Voluntary Exit Offer details within the next few hours.

blocks.text: The Voluntary Exit Offer is new for us. We’ll learn from it. At the same time, we’ll keep helping people focus on the work that matters most, build new skills and, where it makes sense, find new opportunities across Microsoft. There is no one-size-fits-all approach for every team or every employee. These are a few of the ways we’re trying to meet different business needs while continuing to create opportunities for our own people to grow and contribute.
blocks.zh: 自愿退出协议对我们来说是新的。我们会从中吸取教训。同时,我们会继续帮助人们专注于最重要的工作,培养新的技能,以及,在有道理的地方,寻找跨微软的新机会.对每个团队或每个员工来说,没有一刀切的做法。这些是我们努力满足不同商业需求, 同时也继续为本国人民创造成长和贡献的机会。
blocks.en: The Voluntary Exit Offer is new for us. We’ll learn from it. At the same time, we’ll keep helping people focus on the work that matters most, build new skills and, where it makes sense, find new opportunities across Microsoft. There is no one-size-fits-all approach for every team or every employee. These are a few of the ways we’re trying to meet different business needs while continuing to create opportunities for our own people to grow and contribute.

blocks.text: My promise is to continue to provide clarity, listen and learn and keep improving.
blocks.zh: 我的承诺是继续提供清晰,倾听和学习 并不断改进。
blocks.en: My promise is to continue to provide clarity, listen and learn and keep improving.

blocks.text: Thank you for everything you continue to do for our customers, Microsoft and for one another.
blocks.zh: 谢谢你为我们客户所做的一切微软和对方。
blocks.en: Thank you for everything you continue to do for our customers, Microsoft and for one another.

blocks.zh: 这个“Viva Generation”文章稍作编辑,供外部使用。
